sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机地想要掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Three-year-old Paul Lanyans arrived in Australia from his hometown of Birmingham, England, on December 22, 1989.
sentences.zh: 1989年12月22日，三岁的保罗·兰扬斯从他的家乡英国伯明翰抵达澳大利亚。

sentences.en: Like many international backpackers before him, Paul had heard great things about the land down under,
sentences.zh: 像许多在他之前的国际背包客一样，保罗听过很多关于这片南半球大陆的美好传闻，

sentences.en: and was looking forward to a summer of travel and adventure, before embarking on a six-month working holiday.
sentences.zh: 并期待着在开始六个月的打工度假之前，能享受一个充满旅行和冒险的夏天。

sentences.en: He spent the first six weeks of his trip staying at a hostel in Sydney, where he visited the sites of the city and hung out with fellow travellers,
sentences.zh: 他在悉尼的一家旅馆住了六周，期间游览了城市景点并结识了其他旅行者，

sentences.en: before deciding to head south to Victoria to see if he could find a job fruit-picking.
sentences.zh: 随后决定南下前往维多利亚州，看看能否找到一份采摘水果的工作。

sentences.en: Paul considered catching a bus for the near 1,000-kilometre journey, but several other backpackers advised him that hitchhiking was easier and a great way to save money.
sentences.zh: 保罗曾考虑搭乘巴士完成这段近1000公里的旅程，但几位背包客建议他搭便车会更方便，也是省钱的好办法。

sentences.en: They recommended he take the tried and tested route, catch a train to Liverpool in Sydney's south-west, walk to the Hume Highway, then hitch a ride south to Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 他们建议他走那条久经考验的路线：先乘火车到悉尼西南部的利物浦，步行至休姆高速公路，然后搭便车南下前往墨尔本。

sentences.en: Following this advice, on January 25, 1990,
sentences.zh: 听从了建议，1990年1月25日，

sentences.en: Paul Lanyans boarded the train to Liverpool, arriving at approximately 1pm.
sentences.zh: 保罗·兰扬斯登上了前往利物浦的火车，大约下午1点到达。

sentences.en: He set off for the Hume Highway on foot, carrying all of his possessions in an old, green-coloured army rucksack.
sentences.zh: 他背着一个装满所有家当的旧绿色军用背包，徒步前往休姆高速公路。

sentences.en: Although traffic was busy, Paul wasn't having any luck hailing a ride, and after an hour of wandering along in the oppressive afternoon sun,
sentences.zh: 尽管车流量很大，但保罗一直没能搭到车。在午后闷热的阳光下漫无目的地走了大约一小时后，

sentences.en: he veered off the highway at the town of Kasula to refresh with a drink and a chocolate bar.
sentences.zh: 他在卡苏拉镇附近离开了高速公路，去买饮料和巧克力棒解暑。

sentences.en: Whilst resting at Lombardo's news agency,
sentences.zh: 在隆巴多报刊亭休息时，

sentences.en: Paul was approached by a stocky, tanned-skinned man with dark hair and light eyes.
sentences.zh: 一个身材敦实、皮肤黝黑、留着深色头发、眼睛明亮的男人向保罗走来。

sentences.en: He had a bushy, horseshoe-shaped moustache that Paul likened to famous Australian cricket player
sentences.zh: 他留着浓密的马蹄形胡须，保罗觉得这很像澳大利亚著名板球运动员

sentences.en: Merv Hughes.
sentences.zh: 默夫·休斯。

sentences.en: The man introduced himself as Bill and asked the British backpacker if he needed a lift, offering to drive him as far as Canberra, a 280-kilometre drive south.
sentences.zh: 那人自称叫比尔，问这位英国背包客是否需要搭车，并主动提出可以载他到280公里外的堪培拉。

sentences.en: Paul gratefully accepted the ride.
sentences.zh: 保罗感激地接受了邀请。

sentences.en: The two men climbed into Bill's silver Nissan Patrol four-wheel-drive vehicle, which had a red stripe down the side, chrome-plated sidesteps, a bull bar,
sentences.zh: 两人坐进了比尔那辆银色的日产途乐四驱车，车身侧面有一条红色的条纹，配有镀铬侧踏板、防撞杆，

sentences.en: curtains on the rear door windows, and lamb's wool seat covers.
sentences.zh: 后窗装有窗帘，座椅上铺着羊毛座套。

sentences.en: Bill threw Paul's rucksack onto the back seat before getting behind the wheel and heading south along the Hume Highway.
sentences.zh: 比尔把保罗的背包扔到后座，随后坐进驾驶座，沿着休姆高速公路向南驶去。

sentences.en: The pair engaged in small talk about the hot weather and Paul's upcoming travel plans.
sentences.zh: 两人闲聊着炎热的天气和保罗接下来的旅行计划。

sentences.en: Bill was friendly and easy to talk to, explaining his family was from Yugoslavia and that he lived locally where he worked for the Roads and Traffic Authority in Liverpool.
sentences.zh: 比尔很友好，容易交谈，他解释说自己的家人来自南斯拉夫，他住在当地，在利物浦的公路与交通管理局工作。

sentences.en: He was recently divorced and currently on a break from work, taking the opportunity to head to Canberra for a holiday with friends.
sentences.zh: 他刚离婚，目前正在休假，正好趁这个机会去堪培拉找朋友度假。

sentences.en: Paul politely responded to Bill's questions, advising that he had no family in Australia and that up until recently he had been in the British Navy.
sentences.zh: 保罗礼貌地回答了比尔的问题，提到他在澳大利亚没有亲人，直到最近才退役，之前在英国海军服役。

sentences.en: Bill asked Paul if he had any special forces training in the military, to which he responded, no.
sentences.zh: 比尔问保罗是否在军队接受过特种部队训练，保罗回答没有。

sentences.en: He worked as an air conditioning engineer.
sentences.zh: 他是一名空调工程师。

sentences.en: Bill's demeanor then started to shift.
sentences.zh: 比尔的态度随后开始发生转变。

sentences.en: A conversation about immigration ensued, during which Bill started to get agitated as he made several anti-British and anti-Asian remarks.
sentences.zh: 话题转到了移民问题上，比尔开始变得激动，并发表了几句反英和反亚裔的言论。

sentences.en: The pair drove onwards in silence,
sentences.zh: 两人沉默地继续前行，

sentences.en: Paul taking the moment to study his tense driver, noticing how Bill kept eyeing the rearview mirror and
sentences.zh: 保罗趁机观察着这位神情紧张的司机，注意到比尔不断地盯着后视镜，

sentences.en: would gradually slow the car down before speeding up again, as though contemplating whether or not to stop.
sentences.zh: 而且车速时快时慢，仿佛在犹豫要不要停车。

sentences.en: Bill then explained that at this point on the highway, the radio signal started to fade and he would need to pull over shortly to grab some cassette tapes to listen to instead.
sentences.zh: 比尔随后解释说，高速公路的这一段收音机信号开始变差，他得找个地方靠边停一下，去拿几盘磁带听。

sentences.en: Paul noted this as odd, as there was already a number of cassette tapes within easy reach between the driver and passenger seats.
sentences.zh: 保罗觉得这很奇怪，因为驾驶座和副驾驶座之间明明触手可及地放着好几盘磁带。

sentences.en: As they came to a rise in the road about one kilometre from the entrance to Belangelo State Forest,
sentences.zh: 当车子行驶到距离贝兰格罗州立森林入口约一公里处的一个坡道时，

sentences.en: Bill pulled the car over and started rummaging around under the driver's seat, saying he was looking for some tapes.
sentences.zh: 比尔把车停在路边，开始在驾驶座下翻找，说是在找磁带。

sentences.en: Paul emerged from the vehicle to stretch his legs, an act that immediately drew Bill's ire, who ordered his passenger to get back in.
sentences.zh: 保罗下车伸展腿脚，这一举动立刻引起了比尔的愤怒，他命令保罗回到车里。

sentences.en: Paul did as he was told and fastened his seatbelt.
sentences.zh: 保罗照做了，并系上了安全带。

sentences.en: Bill rummaged under the driver's seat once more, before lifting out a revolver and pointing it at
sentences.zh: 比尔再次在驾驶座下翻找，随后掏出一把左轮手枪指向

sentences.en: Paul's face, saying, this is a robbery.
sentences.zh: 保罗的脸，说道：“这是抢劫。”

sentences.en: Paul sighted the shiny copper ends of at least four bullets in the handgun's cylinder, confirming the weapon was loaded.
sentences.zh: 保罗看到了手枪弹巢里至少四颗子弹闪亮的铜色弹头，确认武器是装了子弹的。

sentences.en: He sat in complete disbelief, wondering if Bill was just having a laugh at his expense.
sentences.zh: 他完全不敢相信，心想比尔是不是在拿他开玩笑。

sentences.en: After all, he was a backpacker travelling on a tight budget with nothing of value.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，他只是一个预算紧张、身无长物的背包客。

sentences.en: He had nothing to steal.
sentences.zh: 他根本没什么可被偷的。

sentences.en: Yet, the menacing look in Bill's eyes assured him this was no joke.
sentences.zh: 然而，比尔眼中凶狠的神情让他确信这不是玩笑。

sentences.en: Paul slowly started unbuckling his seatbelt, causing Bill to bark, put that fucking seatbelt back on.
sentences.zh: 保罗慢慢开始解开安全带，比尔立刻吼道：“把那该死的安全带系回去。”

sentences.en: When Bill pulled out a bag full of ropes, Paul knew he had to escape the situation immediately.
sentences.zh: 当比尔掏出一袋绳子时，保罗知道他必须立刻逃离这里。

sentences.en: The bag of ropes seemed far more sinister to him than the gun did.
sentences.zh: 那袋绳子在他看来比枪还要阴森恐怖。

sentences.en: In a split-second decision, he unclipped his seatbelt and leapt from the car, racing northwards up the Hume Highway.
sentences.zh: 他当机立断，解开安全带跳下车，沿着休姆高速公路向北狂奔。

sentences.en: Bill yelled out, stop or I'll shoot, before firing at Paul.
sentences.zh: 比尔大喊：“站住，不然我就开枪了！”随后向保罗开火。

sentences.en: The bullets missed, as the backpacker started running in a zigzag motion to make himself a harder target to hit.
sentences.zh: 子弹打偏了，保罗开始以之字形路线奔跑，让自己更难被击中。

sentences.en: Paul Onions, quote,
sentences.zh: 保罗·奥尼恩斯回忆道：

sentences.en: I started running across the roadway and three or four cars swerved to miss me, but nobody would stop.
sentences.zh: “我开始横穿马路，有三四辆车为了避开我而急转弯，但没人停下来。”

sentences.en: I looked up and didn't see any cars coming, and I turned around for the first time and there was Bill chasing me.
sentences.zh: “我抬头看去，没发现有车过来，我第一次回头看，发现比尔正在追我。”

sentences.en: He was yelling at me, get back in the car, get back in the car.
sentences.zh: “他冲我大喊：‘滚回车里去，滚回车里去！’”

sentences.en: The two men reached the grassy median strip in the centre of the highway, where Bill launched at Paul, grabbing him by the right sleeve of his shirt.
sentences.zh: 两人跑到了高速公路中央的草地隔离带，比尔扑向保罗，抓住了他衬衫的右袖。

sentences.en: The fabric tore, giving Paul one last chance to escape.
sentences.zh: 布料被扯破了，这给了保罗最后一次逃脱的机会。

sentences.en: He ran towards oncoming traffic whilst frantically waving his arms in the air as a Tarago van with a female driver approached.
sentences.zh: 他冲向迎面而来的车流，疯狂地挥舞着双臂，这时一辆由女性驾驶的塔拉戈面包车开了过来。

sentences.en: Paul stood directly in its way, deciding he would rather be run over than face whatever Bill had in store for him.
sentences.zh: 保罗直接挡在车前，心想宁可被撞死，也不愿面对比尔对他做出的任何事。

sentences.en: When the van came to an abrupt stop, Paul ran to the passenger side sliding door, pulled it open, and jumped inside.
sentences.zh: 当面包车猛地停下时，保罗跑到副驾驶侧的滑动门旁，拉开车门跳了进去。

sentences.en: He locked the door behind him while yelling at the confused driver, he's got a gun, he's got a gun.
sentences.zh: 他锁上车门，冲着那位困惑的司机大喊：“他有枪，他有枪！”

sentences.en: The driver of the Tarago, Joanne Berry, sped away and took Paul straight to Bowerall Police Station, where he reported his near-death confrontation with Bill.
sentences.zh: 塔拉戈面包车的司机乔安妮·贝里加速驶离，直接将保罗送到了鲍拉尔警察局，他在那里报告了与比尔那次九死一生的对峙。

sentences.en: He explained that his rucksack was in Bill's car, containing all of his belongings, including clothing,
sentences.zh: 他解释说他的背包在比尔的车里，里面装着他所有的财物，包括衣物、

sentences.en: a camera, a plane ticket, $500 cash, his British passport, a gold chain, and some personal papers.
sentences.zh: 相机、机票、500美元现金、英国护照、金项链和一些个人证件。

sentences.en: A message was broadcast over police radio notifying officers to be on the lookout for a silver Nissan
sentences.zh: 警方通过电台发布消息，通知警员留意一辆银色的日产

sentences.en: Patrol four-wheel drive vehicle being driven by a man with a Merv Hughes-style moustache.
sentences.zh: 途乐四驱车，驾驶者是一名留着默夫·休斯式胡须的男子。

sentences.en: Given that Paul was unable to take note of the vehicle's number plate, he was advised that the chances of locating his assailant would be slim.
sentences.zh: 由于保罗没能记下车牌号，警方告知他找到袭击者的几率很小。

sentences.en: Before Paul left the police station, a senior officer pulled him aside to tell him how lucky he was to be alive, hoping the experience provided the foreign
sentences.zh: 在保罗离开警察局前，一名高级警官把他拉到一边，告诉他能活下来是多么幸运，并希望这次经历能给这位外国

sentences.en: backpacker a valuable lesson on the dangers of hitchhiking.
sentences.zh: 背包客上一堂关于搭便车危险性的宝贵课程。

sentences.en: Paul was handed money for a train trip back to Sydney, where he returned to his former hostel and warned other travellers of his ordeal.
sentences.zh: 保罗领到了回悉尼的火车票钱，他回到之前的旅馆，向其他旅行者警告了自己的遭遇。

sentences.en: Paul remained in Australia for several months before returning to England, vowing to never hitchhike again.
sentences.zh: 保罗在澳大利亚又待了几个月才回到英国，并发誓再也不搭便车了。

sentences.en: Four years later, the unsolved murders of James Gibson,
sentences.zh: 四年后，詹姆斯·吉布森、

sentences.en: Deborah Everest, Simone Schmiddle, Gabor Neugebauer, Anya Habschied, Joanne Walters, and Caroline Clark received heavy coverage by international media outlets.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉·埃弗雷斯特、西蒙娜·施密德尔、加博尔·诺伊格鲍尔、安雅·哈布希德、乔安妮·沃尔特斯和卡罗琳·克拉克的未解谋杀案受到了国际媒体的广泛报道。

sentences.en: They titled the killer The Beast of the Bush as UK tabloids published unsubstantiated claims that the perpetrator had murdered 20 people across two decades.
sentences.zh: 他们将凶手称为“丛林野兽”，英国小报刊登了未经证实的说法，称凶手在二十年间谋杀了20人。

sentences.en: One crude headline read,
sentences.zh: 一条粗俗的标题写道：

sentences.en: Crocodile Dundee Adventure Girls Found Dead in the Woods, whilst Australia-phobic articles declared,
sentences.zh: “鳄鱼邓迪冒险女孩在树林中被发现死亡”，而一些仇视澳大利亚的文章则宣称：

sentences.en: 250,000 people a year trekked to danger.
sentences.zh: “每年有25万人徒步走向危险。”

sentences.en: As a direct result of the murders, Australia was ranked by foreign media as one of the five most dangerous locations for tourists to accept a ride from strangers.
sentences.zh: 由于这些谋杀案的直接影响，澳大利亚被外国媒体列为游客搭乘陌生人车辆最危险的五个地点之一。

sentences.en: Listed alongside South Africa, Chile, Zimbabwe, and the United States.
sentences.zh: 与南非、智利、津巴布韦和美国并列。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the Belengalo area had reached instant notoriety, prompting visitors to venture into the forest to satisfy their morbid curiosity.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，贝兰格罗地区瞬间臭名昭著，促使游客冒险进入森林以满足病态的好奇心。

sentences.en: Belengalo signs along the Hume Highway were stolen on two separate occasions by visitors seeking a macabre souvenir.
sentences.zh: 休姆高速公路沿线的贝兰格罗路标曾两次被寻求恐怖纪念品的游客偷走。

sentences.en: As Englishman Paul Onions read news reports of the seven backpackers found murdered in Australia, he felt a shiver run up his spine.
sentences.zh: 当英国人保罗·奥尼恩斯读到关于在澳大利亚发现七名背包客被谋杀的新闻报道时，他感到脊背发凉。

sentences.en: He immediately recognised the similarities between the crimes and his encounter with Bill on the Hume
sentences.zh: 他立刻意识到这些罪行与他1990年1月在休姆

sentences.en: Highway in January 1990.
sentences.zh: 高速公路上与比尔的遭遇之间存在相似之处。

sentences.en: Paul picked up the phone and contacted Australian authorities, realising he may have survived a brush with the Belengalo serial killer.
sentences.zh: 保罗拿起电话联系了澳大利亚当局，意识到他可能在与贝兰格罗连环杀手的接触中幸存了下来。

sentences.en: Paul Onions' harrowing escape was corroborated by his rescuer, Joanne Berry, who had independently reported the incident via the taskforce air hotline.
sentences.zh: 保罗·奥尼恩斯的惊险逃生得到了他的救命恩人乔安妮·贝里的证实，她曾独立通过专案组热线报告了这一事件。

sentences.en: The formal statement the British backpacker provided Boweral Police immediately following the attack had been misplaced over the years.
sentences.zh: 这位英国背包客在袭击发生后立即向鲍拉尔警方提供的正式陈述，多年来已经遗失了。

sentences.en: However, one officer who had been on duty that day still had a notebook that contained some details she had jotted down about the incident,
sentences.zh: 然而，当天值班的一名警官仍然保留着一本笔记本，里面记录了她当时随手记下的一些细节，

sentences.en: including that the perpetrator had a distinct horseshoe moustache in the same style as Australian
sentences.zh: 包括袭击者留着与澳大利亚板球运动员默夫·休斯同款的独特马蹄形胡须，

sentences.en: cricket player Merv Hughes, drove a silver four-wheel drive, was of Yugoslavian descent and claimed to have worked at the Roads and Traffic Authority.
sentences.zh: 开着一辆银色四驱车，是南斯拉夫裔，并声称曾在公路与交通管理局工作。

sentences.en: Four and a half months after the last of the seven young backpackers were uncovered in Belengalo, a shared memorial service was held in the forest at the former
sentences.zh: 在贝兰格罗发现最后一名年轻背包客遗体的四个半月后，在森林里原先的

sentences.en: side of the police command poSt. February 5 1994 was a scorching hot day, but despite the heat,
sentences.zh: 警察指挥所旧址举行了一场联合追悼会。1994年2月5日是一个酷热难耐的日子，但尽管天气炎热，

sentences.en: over 200 mourners gathered to pay their respects to the victims and to their loved ones, with relatives, friends, locals and officials in attendance.
sentences.zh: 仍有200多名哀悼者聚集在一起，向受害者及其亲人表达敬意，亲属、朋友、当地居民和官员均出席了仪式。

sentences.en: For Anglican Reverend Steve Davis, the service aimed to help help the community and families come to terms with the tragedy, closing one chapter while ensuring the
sentences.zh: 对于圣公会史蒂夫·戴维斯牧师来说，这场仪式旨在帮助社区和家庭接受这场悲剧，在翻开新篇章的同时，确保

sentences.en: case remained in the spotlight until it was solved.

sentences.zh: “你也永远查不出是谁干的。”

sentences.en: A few weeks later, the topic came up again, during which Richard allegedly stated,
sentences.zh: 几周后，这个话题再次被提起，期间理查德据称声称：

sentences.en: There are more bodies out there.
sentences.zh: “外面还有更多的尸体。”

sentences.en: They haven't found them all yet.
sentences.zh: “他们还没把他们全部找到。”

sentences.en: A year later, shortly after James Gibson and Deborah Everest's remains were uncovered in Belangelo, an unrelated rape case was making national news.
sentences.zh: 一年后，在詹姆斯·吉布森和黛博拉·埃弗雷特的遗骸在贝朗格洛被发现后不久，一起无关的强奸案成为了全国新闻。

sentences.en: Richard Mallatt was discussing the news story at work when, according to Paul Douglas, he allegedly remarked,
sentences.zh: 理查德·马拉特正在工作中讨论这则新闻，据保罗·道格拉斯称，他当时评论道：

sentences.en: Stabbing a woman is like cutting a loaf of bread.
sentences.zh: “捅一个女人就像切一条面包一样。”

sentences.en: Paul was taken aback by the sinister remark, but shrugged it off, as Richard's bizarre comments were widely considered to be nothing more than drug-induced ramblings.
sentences.zh: 保罗被这句阴险的话吓了一跳，但并没有放在心上，因为理查德那些怪异的言论被广泛认为不过是毒品引起的胡言乱语。

sentences.en: It wasn't until the final three Belangelo victims were discovered,
sentences.zh: 直到最后三名贝朗格洛受害者被发现，

sentences.en: German citizens Simone Schmidl,
sentences.zh: 德国公民西蒙娜·施密德尔、

sentences.en: Gabor Neugebauer and Dania Habschied, that Paul felt uneasy, recalling the time Richard allegedly claimed that they hadn't found the Germans yet.
sentences.zh: 加博尔·诺伊鲍尔和丹妮亚·哈布希德，保罗才感到不安，回想起理查德曾声称他们还没找到德国人的那次谈话。

sentences.en: Paul voiced his concerns to fellow colleague Des Butler, who was reminded of his own strange conversation with Richard, during which the man allegedly made the ominous statement,
sentences.zh: 保罗向同事德斯·巴特勒表达了他的担忧，德斯·巴特勒想起了自己与理查德那次奇怪的谈话，当时那个人据称说了那句不祥的话：

sentences.en: I know who killed the Germans.
sentences.zh: “我知道是谁杀了那些德国人。”

sentences.en: Des Butler called the Crimestoppers hotline as his wife passed on Richard Mallatt's details to a detective she knew personally.
sentences.zh: 德斯·巴特勒拨打了灭罪热线，他的妻子将理查德·马拉特的详细信息转达给了一位她私下认识的侦探。

sentences.en: A background check revealed Richard had prior convictions for breaking and entering, theft, cannabis possession, and various traffic offences.
sentences.zh: 背景调查显示，理查德此前有入室盗窃、偷窃、持有大麻和各种交通违规的前科。

sentences.en: As a precaution, his details were handed over to Task Force Air.
sentences.zh: 作为预防措施，他的详细信息被移交给了“空中特遣部队”。

sentences.en: The Mallatt name had actually been on Task Force Air's radar since mid-October 1993,
sentences.zh: 马拉特这个名字实际上从1993年10月中旬起就在“空中特遣部队”的监视名单上了，

sentences.en: when only four of the seven Belangelo victims had been found.
sentences.zh: 当时七名贝朗格洛受害者中只有四名被发现。

sentences.en: During investigations at the time, detectives visited the Pistol Club in Boweral, the community on Belangelo's outskirts,
sentences.zh: 在当时的调查中，侦探们走访了位于贝朗格洛郊外社区鲍勒尔的手枪俱乐部，

sentences.en: where a club leader advised them to speak to one of their members named Alexander Mallatt.
sentences.zh: 一位俱乐部负责人建议他们与他们的一名成员亚历山大·马拉特谈谈。

sentences.en: The 53-year-old, who went by Alex, attended Boweral Police Station two days later to detail an incident he witnessed on April 26, 1992,
sentences.zh: 这位53岁、大家都叫他亚历克斯的人，两天后前往鲍勒尔警察局，详细说明了他在1992年4月26日目击的一起事件，

sentences.en: one week after British backpackers Joanne Walters and Caroline Clark went missing.
sentences.zh: 那是在英国背包客乔安妮·沃尔特斯和卡罗琳·克拉克失踪一周后。

sentences.en: Whilst driving home from the Pistol Club with a friend,
sentences.zh: 当他和朋友从手枪俱乐部开车回家时，

sentences.en: Alex passed two vehicles, a brown Ford Falcon sedan and a brown four-wheel drive.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯超过了两辆车，一辆棕色的福特猎鹰轿车和一辆棕色的四驱车。

sentences.en: The two vehicles were entering the access road into Belangelo State ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 这两辆车正驶入通往贝朗格洛州立森林的通道。

sentences.en: Both vehicles contained several male occupants, with one woman positioned in the back seat of each vehicle between two men.
sentences.zh: 两辆车里都坐着几名男性，每辆车的后座上都有一名女性被夹在两名男子中间。

sentences.en: Upon passing the vehicles,
sentences.zh: 在超过这些车辆时，

sentences.en: Alex made eye contact with the women, who were gagged and frightened.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯与那些被堵住嘴且惊恐万状的女性进行了眼神交流。

sentences.en: He could no longer recall the vehicle's licence plate numbers, but was able to provide an extraordinary level of detail in his descriptions of the men in the cars,
sentences.zh: 他已经记不起车辆的车牌号码了，但能够对他描述车内男子的外貌提供极其详尽的细节，

sentences.en: including their complexions, hairstyles and tattoos.
sentences.zh: 包括他们的肤色、发型和纹身。

sentences.en: When asked why he didn't think to report this incident to the police when it happened, or after Joanne Walters and Caroline Clark's remains were found,
sentences.zh: 当被问及为什么在事件发生时，或者在乔安妮·沃尔特斯和卡罗琳·克拉克的遗骸被发现后，没有想到向警方报告此事时，

sentences.en: Alex Mallatt explained he thought it was,
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·马拉特解释说他以为是：

sentences.en: Just some young blokes taking some girls into the forest to have a good time.
sentences.zh: “只是一些年轻小伙子带几个女孩进森林去玩玩而已。”

sentences.en: Detectives questioned Alex's driving companion, Bill Ayres, who also witnessed the two vehicles heading into Belangelo that day.
sentences.zh: 侦探们询问了亚历克斯的同车伙伴比尔·艾尔斯，他也目击了那天两辆车驶向贝朗格洛。

sentences.en: But Bill could not corroborate Alex's account of the two restrained women.
sentences.zh: 但比尔无法证实亚历克斯关于两名被控制女性的说法。

sentences.en: Alex's statement raised many questions for the head of Task Force Air,
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯的陈述为“空中特遣部队”的负责人提出了许多疑问，

sentences.en: Superintendent Clive Small, who later commented in his book,
sentences.zh: 警司克莱夫·斯莫尔后来在他的书中评论道，

sentences.en: Inside Australia's Biggest Manhunt.
sentences.zh: 《深入澳大利亚最大的搜捕行动》。

sentences.en: Given he had been looking through the window of a moving vehicle, the level of detail in Alex's statement was extraordinary, not to say bizarre.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他是通过行驶中车辆的窗户看到的，亚历克斯陈述中的细节程度非常惊人，甚至可以说是离奇。

sentences.en: Questions began to pile up in my mind.
sentences.zh: 我的脑海里开始堆积起疑问。

sentences.en: Was it a complete fabrication?
sentences.zh: 这是完全捏造的吗？

sentences.en: If so, what was Alex's motive?
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，亚历克斯的动机是什么？

sentences.en: Was Alex involved in the murders and playing a game with the Task Force?
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯是否参与了谋杀，并在和特遣部队玩游戏？

sentences.en: Did Alex know something about the murders, and was he trying to tell the Task Force something without coming out directly and providing that information?
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯是否知道关于谋杀案的一些事情，他是否试图在不直接提供信息的情况下告诉特遣部队一些事情？

sentences.en: Alex's statement was passed between Task Force Air detectives over the course of the investigation,
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯的陈述在调查过程中在“空中特遣部队”的侦探之间传阅，

sentences.en: until one recognised the Mallatt surname from other tip-offs provided by the public.
sentences.zh: 直到其中一人从公众提供的其他线索中认出了马拉特这个姓氏。

sentences.en: Alex's younger brother Richard had been name-dropped to investigators for the chewing remarks he allegedly made to co-workers about the murders.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯的弟弟理查德因为据称对同事发表的关于谋杀案的轻率言论而被调查人员点名。

sentences.en: And a third Mallatt brother, Ivan, had been named through the hotline, as he had family with property not far from Billangelo,
sentences.zh: 而第三个马拉特兄弟伊万也通过热线被点名，因为他在离贝朗格洛不远的地方有家族房产，

sentences.en: drove a four-wheel drive, and possessed several firearMs.
sentences.zh: 开着一辆四驱车，并拥有几支枪支。

sentences.en: Curious to discover what else they could find about the three siblings, a team of five detectives were tasked to conduct a further investigation into the Mallatt family.
sentences.zh: 出于好奇想看看还能发现关于这三个兄弟的什么信息，一个由五名侦探组成的团队被指派对马拉特家族进行进一步调查。

sentences.en: As described in the book Sins of the Brother by Mark Whittaker and Delez Kennedy, the Mallatt family was extensive, consisting of 14 children in total,
sentences.zh: 正如马克·惠特克和德莱兹·肯尼迪在《兄弟的罪孽》一书中所述，马拉特家族人丁兴旺，共有14个孩子，

sentences.en: 10 sons and four daughters.
sentences.zh: 10个儿子和4个女儿。

sentences.en: The family's patriarch, Stephen Mallatt, moved to Sydney from Croatia in 1926, seeking better employment prospects.
sentences.zh: 家族大家长斯蒂芬·马拉特于1926年从克罗地亚搬到悉尼，寻求更好的就业前景。

sentences.en: In 1934, 32-year-old Stephen was walking along the street when a 14-year-old girl named Margaret Piddleston rode into him on her bicycle.
sentences.zh: 1934年，32岁的斯蒂芬走在街上时，一个名叫玛格丽特·皮德尔斯顿的14岁女孩骑自行车撞到了他。

sentences.en: Margaret invited Stephen back to her home for a cup of tea and the two started spending time together reading, listening to the radio, and going to the movies.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特邀请斯蒂芬回她家喝茶，两人开始在一起读书、听广播和看电影。

sentences.en: Stephen proposed to Margaret when she was 15 years old and to the pair were married in her parents' backyard a year later.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬在玛格丽特15岁时向她求婚，一年后两人在她父母的后院结婚了。

sentences.en: The newlyweds moved to a small flat in a working-class suburb of Sydney, where Stephen laboured as a wharfie on the harbour's waterfront.
sentences.zh: 这对新婚夫妇搬到了悉尼一个工人阶级郊区的小公寓里，斯蒂芬在那里做码头工人。

sentences.en: In 1937, they relocated to the rural area of Canley Vale to a property with no electricity or plumbing.
sentences.zh: 1937年，他们搬到了坎利谷的农村地区，住进了一处没有电力或管道的房产。

sentences.en: Their first child, Olga, was born two years later, followed by 13 more children over the next 23 years.
sentences.zh: 他们的第一个孩子奥尔加两年后出生，随后在接下来的23年里又生了13个孩子。

sentences.en: Alexander, Boris, Mary, Ivan, Shirley, William, Michael, Walter,
sentences.zh: 亚历山大、鲍里斯、玛丽、伊万、雪莉、威廉、迈克尔、沃尔特、

sentences.en: George, Margaret, Richard, David, and Paul.
sentences.zh: 乔治、玛格丽特、理查德、大卫和保罗。

sentences.en: At one stage, Stephen partnered with his father-in-law to establish a market garden that ultimately provided him enough money
sentences.zh: 有段时间，斯蒂芬与他的岳父合伙建立了一个菜园，最终为他提供了足够的钱

sentences.en: to buy a significant block of land in the south-west Sydney suburb of Moorbank in the Liverpool district.
sentences.zh: 去购买位于利物浦区悉尼西南部郊区穆尔班克的一大块土地。

sentences.en: He quit working on the wharves and, with the help of his many children, grew tomatoes, cabbages, and other vegetables.
sentences.zh: 他辞去了码头的工作，在许多孩子的帮助下，种植西红柿、卷心菜和其他蔬菜。

sentences.en: Although their garden was successful, the Malatt family remained on the poverty line, living in a two-room shack with dirt-packed floors
sentences.zh: 尽管他们的菜园很成功，但马拉特一家仍处于贫困线，住在一个泥土地面的两室棚屋里，

sentences.en: where everyone worked long hours sustaining the crops and slept on the ground.
sentences.zh: 每个人都要长时间工作来维持庄稼，并睡在地上。

sentences.en: Stephen started drinking heavily and was prone to violent outbursts at his wife and children, with neighbours describing him as a brute.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬开始酗酒，并容易对妻子和孩子施暴，邻居们形容他是个野蛮人。

sentences.en: When Stephen was 52, his entire harvest of tomatoes was stolen in the middle of the night, prompting him to give up gardening and accept a job working 12-hour shifts
sentences.zh: 当斯蒂芬52岁时，他所有的西红柿收成在半夜被偷了，这促使他放弃了园艺，接受了一份做12小时轮班的工作，

sentences.en: as a labourer for a concrete manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 担任一家混凝土制造商的劳工。

sentences.en: Each day he walked the 20-kilometre round trip to his new workplace, giving the Malatt children plenty of time without the supervision and discipline of their father.
sentences.zh: 他每天往返20公里去新工作地点，这让马拉特家的孩子们有充足的时间脱离父亲的监督和管教。

sentences.en: The Malatt siblings had spent so much of their youth working in their father's gardens that they had socialised very little with other children.
sentences.zh: 马拉特兄弟姐妹年轻时大部分时间都在父亲的菜园里工作，以至于他们与其他孩子的社交很少。

sentences.en: Many days were spent exploring the bush surrounding their rural property where they shot targets, rabbits, and birds.
sentences.zh: 许多日子是在探索他们农村房产周围的丛林中度过的，他们在那里射击目标、兔子和鸟类。

sentences.en: The Malatt brothers attended a Catholic high school in Liverpool where the teachers were known to hand out disciplinary beatings,
sentences.zh: 马拉特兄弟在利物浦的一所天主教高中上学，那里的老师以体罚学生而闻名，

sentences.en: leading the boys to have a disdain for authority figures.
sentences.zh: 导致这些男孩对权威人物产生了蔑视。

sentences.en: Several developed a reputation for getting into fights, skipping class, and finding themselves in trouble with the law.
sentences.zh: 其中几个人因打架、逃课和惹上法律麻烦而臭名昭著。

sentences.en: Every couple of days, the police would appear on Margaret Malatt's doorstep to report some kind of incident involving her sons.
sentences.zh: 每隔几天，警察就会出现在玛格丽特·马拉特的家门口，报告涉及她儿子的某种事件。

sentences.en: The mother was quick to defend her children, insisting the officers had made a mistake and naming other children in the neighbourhood as the ones to blame.
sentences.zh: 这位母亲很快就会为她的孩子辩护，坚称警察搞错了，并指名道姓说是邻居家的其他孩子干的。

sentences.en: Margaret would then withhold the boys' misbehaviour from their father to spare them from harsh punishment.
sentences.zh: 然后玛格丽特会向他们的父亲隐瞒男孩们的恶行，以使他们免受严厉的惩罚。

sentences.en: Stephen and Margaret Malatt sold the Moorbank property and bought a house on Campbell Hill Road in the western Sydney suburb of Guildford,
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬和玛格丽特·马拉特卖掉了穆尔班克的房产，在悉尼西部郊区吉尔福德的坎贝尔山路买了一栋房子，

sentences.en: where many of their children remained well into their adult years.
sentences.zh: 他们的许多孩子成年后仍住在那里。

sentences.en: In 1971, their youngest daughter,
sentences.zh: 1971年，他们最小的女儿，

sentences.en: 16-year-old Margaret, was killed in a car accident just one kilometre from the family home while her brother Walter was behind to the wheel.
sentences.zh: 16岁的玛格丽特在离家仅一公里处的一场车祸中丧生，当时她的哥哥沃尔特正在开车。

sentences.en: The loss had a devastating impact on the family.
sentences.zh: 这次损失对家庭造成了毁灭性的影响。

sentences.en: Just over a decade later, in 1983,
sentences.zh: 仅仅十年后，即1983年，

sentences.en: Stephen Malatt died of cancer at the age of 81.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·马拉特死于癌症，享年81岁。

sentences.en: By 1993, many of the Malatt siblings still lived in the southwest Sydney area and some resided in the Southern Highlands region.
sentences.zh: 到1993年，许多马拉特兄弟姐妹仍住在悉尼西南部地区，有些人居住在南部高地地区。

sentences.en: A cursory background check into the Malatt family revealed some members had criminal records ranging from minor traffic offences to more serious crimes
sentences.zh: 对马拉特家族的初步背景调查显示，一些成员有犯罪记录，从轻微的交通违规到更严重的犯罪，

sentences.en: including extortion and armed robbery.
sentences.zh: 包括勒索和武装抢劫。

sentences.en: One of the more problematic Malatt sons,
sentences.zh: 马拉特家的问题儿子之一，

sentences.en: Ivan, was a loner who had a proclivity towards antisocial and criminal behaviour from a young age.
sentences.zh: 伊万，是一个独行侠，从小就有反社会和犯罪行为的倾向。

sentences.en: At 13 years old, he was sent to a residential school for adolescent boys with behavioural issues, but it had little impact on curbing his troublesome ways.
sentences.zh: 13岁时，他被送往一所针对有行为问题的青少年男子的寄宿学校，但这对他遏制麻烦行为几乎没有影响。

sentences.en: When he returned home a year later,
sentences.zh: 一年后他回到家，

sentences.en: Ivan began committing thefts and break-ins, resulting in a six-month stint in a juvenile detention centre at age 17.
sentences.zh: 伊万开始实施盗窃和入室抢劫，导致他在17岁时在少年拘留中心待了六个月。

sentences.en: 19-year-old Ivan broke into a shop and stole a car battery but managed to flee the scene before police arrived.
sentences.zh: 19岁的伊万闯入一家商店偷了一个汽车电池，但在警察到达之前设法逃离了现场。

sentences.en: Officers found Ivan's older brother,
sentences.zh: 警察发现伊万的哥哥，

sentences.en: Boris, waiting in a car nearby and subsequently charged him for the robbery.
sentences.zh: 鲍里斯，在附近的车里等着，随后指控他抢劫。

sentences.en: Boris refused to name his accomplice and his loyalty ensured Ivan went unpunished.
sentences.zh: 鲍里斯拒绝供出同伙，他的忠诚确保了伊万没有受到惩罚。

sentences.en: The following year,
sentences.zh: 第二年，

sentences.en: Ivan received his first adult conviction for break-and-denter and was sentenced to 18 months in prison.
sentences.zh: 伊万因入室盗窃罪首次被判处成年人刑罚，被判入狱18个月。

sentences.en: A month after his parole,
sentences.zh: 假释一个月后，

sentences.en: Ivan and his brother William, or Bill as he was known, were arrested for driving a stolen car.
sentences.zh: 伊万和他的兄弟威廉（人称比尔）因驾驶一辆被盗车辆被捕。

sentences.en: Ivan went on the run prior to court proceedings, leaving Bill to face an 18-month prison term for the crime.
sentences.zh: 伊万在法庭诉讼程序开始前潜逃，留下比尔独自承担了该罪行带来的18个月监禁。

sentences.en: With the help of his mother,
sentences.zh: 在母亲的帮助下，

sentences.en: Ivan was able to evade police detection for several months before his eventual capture.
sentences.zh: 伊万在最终被捕前成功躲避了警方的搜捕长达数月。

sentences.en: In court,
sentences.zh: 在法庭上，

sentences.en: Boris Mallatt perjured himself on the witness stand in an attempt to provide his brother a false alibi, but Ivan was found guilty and sentenced to two years' hard labour
sentences.zh: 鲍里斯·马拉特在证人席上作伪证，试图为他的兄弟提供虚假的不在场证明，但伊万最终被判有罪，并被判处两年苦役，

sentences.en: at the notoriously rough
sentences.zh: 关押在臭名昭著的

sentences.en: Grafton Maximum Security Prison.
sentences.zh: 格拉夫顿最高安全级别监狱。

sentences.en: After being released on parole in April 1967,
sentences.zh: 1967年4月获得假释后，

sentences.en: out their neighbourhood to plan an elaborate robbery.
sentences.zh: 他们的社区，计划进行一场精心策划的抢劫。

sentences.en: One neighbour called police to report the suspicious vehicles and was advised that they were part of a major operation, which quickly became the talk of Eaglevale.
sentences.zh: 一位邻居打电话给警方报告了这些可疑车辆，并被告知它们是一项重大行动的一部分，这很快成了鹰谷的热门话题。

sentences.en: During the early days of the surveillance operation on Ivan Malat, Superintendent
sentences.zh: 在对伊万·马拉特进行监视行动的初期，警司

sentences.en: Small was interviewed about the Belangelo serial killer case for the ABC's current affairs program, Four Corners.
sentences.zh: 克莱夫·斯莫尔（Clive Small）接受了美国广播公司（ABC）时事节目《四个角落》（Four Corners）关于贝兰格洛连环杀手案的采访。

sentences.en: The interview took place in Small's office, where he firmly denied that there were any suspects in the killings.
sentences.zh: 采访是在斯莫尔的办公室进行的，他坚决否认这些杀人案有任何嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Unbeknownst to the superintendent, the footage captured a whiteboard positioned behind him which displayed the words
sentences.zh: 警司不知道的是，拍摄的画面捕捉到了他身后的一块白板，上面写着

sentences.en: Air slash Malat.
sentences.zh: “空中/马拉特”（Air slash Malat）。

sentences.en: When the program aired on March 4, 1994, an astute viewer noticed this detail and contacted both the ABC and Task Force Air Detectives to complain.
sentences.zh: 当节目于1994年3月4日播出时，一位敏锐的观众注意到了这个细节，并联系了ABC和“空中特遣部队”的侦探进行投诉。

sentences.en: The viewer was Alex Malat, who was unaware his younger brother was being viewed as a suspect for the murders.
sentences.zh: 这名观众是亚历克斯·马拉特（Alex Malat），他不知道他的弟弟被视为谋杀案的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Alex was concerned the whiteboard featured his surname due to the previous statements he had provided to police regarding the two gagged women he witnessed being driven into
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯担心白板上出现了他的姓氏，因为他之前曾向警方提供过关于他目击两名被堵住嘴的女子被带往

sentences.en: Belangelo.
sentences.zh: 贝兰格洛的陈述。

sentences.en: Four Corners agreed to pixelate the Malat name during repeats of the episode and nothing further came of it.
sentences.zh: 《四个角落》同意在重播该集时对“马拉特”这个名字进行像素化处理，此后便没有再发生什么事。

sentences.en: Task Force Air had narrowly avoided a close call that could have jeopardised their entire operation.
sentences.zh: “空中特遣部队”险些酿成大祸，这本可能危及他们的整个行动。

sentences.en: As the surveillance continued into mid-March, investigators grew increasingly concerned that their suspect may be on to them.
sentences.zh: 随着监视行动持续到3月中旬，调查人员越来越担心他们的嫌疑人可能已经察觉到了他们。

sentences.en: Inquiries by one detective hadn't been as discreet as directed and Ivan had been informed by colleagues and associates that police were
sentences.zh: 一名侦探的调查并不像指示的那样谨慎，伊万已经从同事和熟人那里得知，警方正在

sentences.en: investigating him in relation to the Belangelo murders.
sentences.zh: 就贝兰格洛谋杀案对他进行调查。

sentences.en: Ivan appeared to be unfazed and would grin at the news, saying he had nothing to worry about.
sentences.zh: 伊万似乎并不为所动，听到这个消息时还会咧嘴一笑，说他没什么可担心的。

sentences.en: In one instance, Ivan was driving with a co-worker who observed a car that appeared to be following them.
sentences.zh: 有一次，伊万和一名同事开车时，同事观察到后面似乎有一辆车在跟着他们。

sentences.en: Ivan calmly stated,
sentences.zh: 伊万平静地说：

sentences.en: That's the coppers.
sentences.zh: “那是警察。”

sentences.en: They're watching me.
sentences.zh: “他们在监视我。”

sentences.en: Although the surveillance operation failed to uncover anything incriminating, it was noted that Ivan suddenly started paying unannounced visits to people he hadn't seen in
sentences.zh: 尽管监视行动未能发现任何确凿证据，但人们注意到伊万突然开始对那些他多年未见的人进行不请自来的拜访，

sentences.en: years, including old neighbours and work colleagues.
sentences.zh: 包括老邻居和同事。

sentences.en: Investigators believed he may have been digging around to see just how far their enquiries had progressed.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，他可能是在四处打探，想看看他们的调查进展到了什么程度。

sentences.en: Concerned that the surveillance might compel their suspect to dispose of evidence, in early April,
sentences.zh: 由于担心监视可能会迫使嫌疑人销毁证据，4月初，

sentences.en: Superintendent Clive Small ordered a temporary halt on the operation while investigators assessed the risk.
sentences.zh: 警司克莱夫·斯莫尔下令暂时停止行动，同时调查人员评估风险。

sentences.en: Eighteen days later, the surveillance was deemed safe to continue.
sentences.zh: 十八天后，监视行动被认为可以安全继续。

sentences.en: As the operation recommenced, police were anxious to uncover some hard evidence to link Ivan Malat to the
sentences.zh: 随着行动重新开始，警方急于发现一些确凿的证据，将伊万·马拉特与

sentences.en: Belangelo murders.
sentences.zh: 贝兰格洛谋杀案联系起来。

sentences.en: They sought assistance from the person that could most likely help identify their suspect.
sentences.zh: 他们寻求了最有可能帮助识别嫌疑人的那个人的协助。

sentences.en: Paul Onions.
sentences.zh: 保罗·昂斯。

sentences.en: Paul arrived in Sydney from England on May 2, 1994, where he agreed to re-enact the events from four years earlier.
sentences.zh: 1994年5月2日，保罗从英国抵达悉尼，他同意重现四年前发生的事件。

sentences.en: Paul took detectives from the Liverpool train station to Lombardo's news agency in Kisoola, where he had accepted a ride from the man who introduced himself as Bill.
sentences.zh: 保罗带着侦探们从利物浦火车站前往基苏拉的隆巴多报刊代理店，他在那里接受了一个自称比尔的男子的搭车邀请。

sentences.en: Paul then drove with detectives along the Hume Highway, where he pointed out the area that his violent confrontation with
sentences.zh: 随后，保罗与侦探们沿着休姆高速公路行驶，他指出了他与

sentences.en: Bill occurred, a location just 900 metres north of the
sentences.zh: 比尔发生暴力冲突的区域，该地点位于

sentences.en: Belangelo forest entrance.
sentences.zh: 贝兰格洛森林入口以北仅900米处。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Paul was shown a video containing the photographs of thirteen different males and was advised to point out any that he recognised as the man who assaulted him in 1990.
sentences.zh: 此后，保罗观看了一段包含十三名不同男性照片的视频，并被建议指出他认出的任何曾在1990年袭击过他的人。

sentences.en: The video played through in full, after which Paul requested to view it again.
sentences.zh: 视频完整播放了一遍，之后保罗要求再看一次。

sentences.en: After the second viewing, he asked to have another look at images four and seven.
sentences.zh: 第二次观看后，他要求再看一遍第四张和第七张照片。

sentences.en: When number four came up, Paul said,
sentences.zh: 当第四张照片出现时，保罗说：

sentences.en: That's him.
sentences.zh: 就是他。

sentences.en: Photograph number four was of Ivan Malat.
sentences.zh: 第四张照片上的人是伊万·米拉特。

sentences.en: Task Force Air now had enough evidence against Ivan Malat to charge him with the attempted abduction and armed robbery of Paul Onions.
sentences.zh: “空中特遣部队”现在掌握了足够的证据，可以以绑架未遂和持械抢劫保罗·奥尼恩斯的罪名起诉伊万·米拉特。

sentences.en: This permitted them to obtain a listening device on the telephone line connected to Ivan's Eaglevale property.
sentences.zh: 这使他们获准在连接伊万伊格尔维尔住所的电话线上安装窃听装置。

sentences.en: They considered installing additional listening devices inside the house, but a complex electronic security system which Ivan activated every time he left home
sentences.zh: 他们曾考虑在屋内安装额外的窃听装置，但伊万每次离家时都会启动一套复杂的电子安全系统，

sentences.en: was near impossible to bypass without detection.
sentences.zh: 这套系统几乎不可能在不被发现的情况下绕过。

sentences.en: Despite Paul Onions positively identifying Ivan as the man who attacked him near
sentences.zh: 尽管保罗·奥尼恩斯明确指认伊万就是那个在

sentences.en: Belangelo, investigators still hadn't obtained any concrete evidence that proved Ivan's
sentences.zh: 贝兰格洛袭击他的人，但调查人员仍未获得任何确凿证据来证明伊万

sentences.en: involvement in the murders of James Gibson, Deborah Everest, Simone Schmidl, Gabor Neugebauer,
sentences.zh: 涉嫌谋杀詹姆斯·吉布森、黛博拉·埃弗雷斯特、西蒙娜·施密德、加博尔·诺伊鲍尔、

sentences.en: Anya Habschied, Joanne Walters, or Caroline Clark.
sentences.zh: 安雅·哈布希德、乔安妮·沃尔特斯或卡罗琳·克拉克。

sentences.en: As criminal profilers were certain the Belangelo serial killer would have retained some of his
sentences.zh: 由于犯罪侧写师确信贝兰格洛连环杀手会保留一些

sentences.en: victims' belongings as morbid trophies, the task force considered conducting a raid of Ivan's home.
sentences.zh: 受害者的物品作为病态战利品，特遣部队考虑对伊万的家进行突击搜查。

sentences.en: Yet, it was a huge risk.
sentences.zh: 然而，这风险巨大。

sentences.en: If they proceeded and found nothing, their cover would be well and truly blown.
sentences.zh: 如果他们行动了却一无所获，他们的卧底身份将彻底暴露。

sentences.en: But, if they managed to find a single item to link Ivan to the crimes, like one of the murder
sentences.zh: 但是，如果他们能找到一件能将伊万与这些罪行联系起来的物品，比如其中一件凶器，

sentences.en: weapons, or a backpack, sleeping bag, or passport belonging to one of the seven victims, they could make their case.
sentences.zh: 或者属于七名受害者之一的背包、睡袋或护照，他们就能立案。

sentences.en: After weighing up the pros and cons, Task Force Air decided to go through with the raid.
sentences.zh: 权衡利弊后，空中特遣部队决定执行突击搜查。

sentences.en: The surveillance team were ordered to continue to keep a close eye on Ivan in the days leading up to the event, in case he attempted to dispose of any evidence.
sentences.zh: 监视小组接到命令，在行动前的几天里继续密切监视伊万，以防他试图销毁任何证据。

sentences.en: The day before the scheduled raid on Ivan Malat's home, two Task Force Air detectives paid a visit
sentences.zh: 在预定突击搜查伊万·米拉特家的前一天，两名空中特遣部队的侦探造访了

sentences.en: to the southern highlands town of Bargo to question Ivan's younger brother Bill and his wife
sentences.zh: 南高地城镇巴戈，询问伊万的弟弟比尔和他的妻子

sentences.en: Carolyn, hoping their visit might generate some chatter on Ivan's phone line.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳，希望他们的造访能在伊万的电话线上引发一些谈话。

sentences.en: The detectives were greeted by the couple's daughter, Debra, who was at the house with her infant son,
sentences.zh: 侦探们受到了这对夫妇的女儿黛布拉的接待，她当时正带着她年幼的儿子在家里，

sentences.en: Matthew, while her parents holidayed in the south coast town of Lake DeBowry.
sentences.zh: 马修，而她的父母正在南海岸的德鲍里湖镇度假。

sentences.en: The detectives advised Debra they wanted to speak to Bill about Ivan's habit of registering vehicles using his name.
sentences.zh: 侦探们告知黛布拉，他们想就伊万以他的名义注册车辆的习惯与比尔谈谈。

sentences.en: When Debra later phoned her father to inform him of the visit, he instructed her to pass the information on to Ivan.
sentences.zh: 当黛布拉后来打电话给父亲告知这次访问时，他指示她把这个消息转告给伊万。

sentences.en: Debra spoke to her uncle that night, but Ivan brushed off her concerns, instead inquiring about his baby nephew, stating,
sentences.zh: 黛布拉当晚与她的叔叔通了话，但伊万对她的担忧不以为意，反而询问起他的小侄子，说道：

sentences.en: Don't worry about it.
sentences.zh: 别担心。

sentences.en: Now, how's little Matthew?
sentences.zh: 对了，小马修怎么样了？

sentences.en: That same day, detectives traveled down to Lake
sentences.zh: 同一天，侦探们前往德鲍里湖

sentences.en: DeBowry to question Bill in person, explaining their inquiries were in relation to an armed robbery.
sentences.zh: 亲自询问比尔，解释他们的调查与一起持械抢劫案有关。

sentences.en: As to why Ivan registered vehicles under his name, Bill stated it was to make use of his rural address, as registration and insurance were cheaper in his area.
sentences.zh: 关于伊万为何以他的名义注册车辆，比尔称这是为了利用他的农村地址，因为在他所在的地区注册和保险更便宜。

sentences.en: Bill later phoned his brother, but once again Ivan expressed no worry that police were actively investigating him.
sentences.zh: 比尔后来给他的兄弟打了电话，但伊万再次表示不担心警方正在积极调查他。

sentences.en: Detectives listening in on the calls pondered whether Ivan's calm reaction was a cover, as he suspected his phone calls were being monitored.
sentences.zh: 监听通话的侦探们琢磨着伊万冷静的反应是否是一种掩饰，因为他怀疑自己的电话正受到监控。

sentences.en: The surveillance team maintained watch of Ivan the entire day, observing that at 1.27pm he traveled to
sentences.zh: 监视小组全天对伊万保持监视，观察到他在下午1点27分前往

sentences.en: the town of Kasula to visit Lombardo's news agency, the very place he once offered a ride to the young foreign traveler, Paul Onions.
sentences.zh: 卡苏拉镇访问隆巴多报刊代理店，正是那个他曾经邀请年轻外国游客保罗·奥尼恩斯搭车的地方。

sentences.en: Elsewhere that same day, the day before the raid was scheduled at Ivan's house, other detectives traveled to Queensland to visit Ivan's brother Alex, who had since relocated
sentences.zh: 同一天，在伊万家预定突击搜查的前一天，其他侦探前往昆士兰州拜访伊万的兄弟亚历克斯，他已经从南高地的家中

sentences.en: interstate from his southern highlands home.
sentences.zh: 搬到了州外。

sentences.en: The timing of his move was of interest to investigators, as it occurred shortly after Joanne Walters and Caroline Clark's remains were discovered in
sentences.zh: 他搬家的时间引起了调查人员的兴趣，因为这发生在乔安妮·沃尔特斯和卡罗琳·克拉克的遗体在

sentences.en: Belangelo.
sentences.zh: 贝兰格洛被发现后不久。

sentences.en: After he and his wife Joan welcomed detectives inside, Alex once again maintained his
sentences.zh: 在他和妻子琼将侦探们迎进屋后，亚历克斯再次坚持他

sentences.en: story about witnessing two restrained women being driven into Belangelo in 1992, scrupulously sticking by his original statement.
sentences.zh: 关于1992年目击两名被捆绑的妇女被带入贝兰格洛的说法，严谨地坚持他最初的陈述。

sentences.en: Since the spotlight had been cast on Ivan, investigators considered the possibility that Alex knew his brother was involved with the murders and made up the bizarre sighting
sentences.zh: 自从焦点转向伊万以来，调查人员考虑了亚历克斯知道他兄弟涉及谋杀案的可能性，并编造了那个离奇的目击事件，

sentences.en: as a way to tip police off without blatantly coming forward and betraying his younger sibling.
sentences.zh: 以此作为一种方式向警方通风报信，而又不至于公然站出来背叛他的弟弟。

sentences.en: Alex admitted to owning ammunition and presented his large supply, which included several .22 caliber
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯承认拥有弹药并展示了他的大量储备，其中包括几枚.22口径

sentences.en: Winchester brand winner-model bullets, the exact same type recovered from Caroline Clark and
sentences.zh: 温彻斯特品牌Winner型号子弹，这与从卡罗琳·克拉克和

sentences.en: Gabor Neugebauer's crime scenes.
sentences.zh: 加博尔·诺伊鲍尔的犯罪现场回收的子弹类型完全相同。

sentences.en: Alex made no comment about the potentially incriminating ammunition.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯对这些可能具有罪证意义的弹药未置一词。

sentences.en: Detectives spoke with Joan and Alex further.
sentences.zh: 侦探们进一步与琼和亚历克斯交谈。

sentences.en: During their conversation, Joan suddenly made an unprompted comment about serial killers and how they often liked to keep souvenirs from their victims, stating, quote,
sentences.zh: 在谈话中，琼突然主动提到连环杀手以及他们通常喜欢保留受害者的纪念品，她引用道：

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，

sentences.en: like backpacks.
sentences.zh: 比如背包。

sentences.en: The stunned detectives remained stone-faced as they asked Joan if she owned any backpacks.
sentences.zh: 震惊的侦探们面无表情地问琼是否拥有任何背包。

sentences.en: Joan nodded and presented a blue Salewa brand pack adorned with a lilac pattern.
sentences.zh: 琼点了点头，拿出一个带有淡紫色图案的蓝色萨利瓦品牌背包。

sentences.en: Joan.
sentences.zh: 琼。

sentences.en: The detectives recognised it immediately.
sentences.zh: 侦探们立刻认出了它。

sentences.en: It was identical to the one carried by Simone
sentences.zh: 它与西蒙娜·施密德背的那个一模一样。

sentences.en: Schmiddle.
sentences.zh: 施密德。

sentences.en: Joan opened up the top flap and pointed out a pair of initials that were imprinted underneath.
sentences.zh: 琼打开顶盖，指出了印在下面的首字母缩写。

sentences.en: I am.
sentences.zh: 我的是。

sentences.en: When asked where she got the backpack from, Joan replied,
sentences.zh: 当被问及这个背包是从哪里得来时，琼回答说：

sentences.en: Ivan gave it to me.
sentences.zh: 伊万给我的。

sentences.en: In the early hours of Sunday, May 22, 1994, Superintendent Small briefed 50 police officers in preparation for their deployment to Eaglevale.
sentences.zh: 1994年5月22日星期日凌晨，斯莫尔警司向50名警官下达了简报，准备部署到伊格尔维尔。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用：

sentences.en: We're here to arrest Ivan Malat over the attempted abduction and attempt to shoot Paul Onions.
sentences.zh: 我们来这里是为了逮捕伊万·米拉特，罪名是绑架未遂和企图枪击保罗·奥尼恩斯。

sentences.en: Malat is considered a violent and dangerous person.
sentences.zh: 米拉特被认为是一个暴力且危险的人。

sentences.en: He is believed to be well-armed.
sentences.zh: 据信他装备精良。

sentences.en: We don't know what to expect and are not taking any chances.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道会发生什么，所以不能有任何侥幸心理。

sentences.en: Six squad cars blocked off Cinnabar Street at both ends while tactical police secured the inner
sentences.zh: 六辆警车封锁了朱砂街的两端，而战术警察确保了伊万住所的内部

sentences.en: perimeter of Ivan's property, where their suspect and his girlfriend Chalinda were sleeping inside.
sentences.zh: 警戒线，他们的嫌疑人和他的女友查琳达当时正在里面睡觉。

sentences.en: By 6.36am, the house was surrounded.
sentences.zh: 到早上6点36分，房子已被包围。

sentences.en: Police negotiator Detective Wayne Gordon placed a phone call to the home and a groggy Ivan Malat picked up, saying,
sentences.zh: 警方谈判专家韦恩·戈登侦探拨通了家里的电话，昏昏沉沉的伊万·米拉特接听了，说道：

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 喂。

sentences.en: To be continued.
sentences.zh: 未完待续。

sentences.en: Next week.
sentences.zh: 下周。
